dedup.rule: Ordinal set membership counts once; duplicate workers are corroborative provenance only.

highest_value_fused_findings: Tool-grounded action/perception receipts are mandatory: generated self-analysis historically fabricated nonexistent defects when routed through ordinary chat.
Authority and grounding gates must be modality-invariant; voice and UI proposal affordances historically bypassed or altered agentic routing semantics.
Recovery must distinguish intended absence/intervention-caused telemetry from failure; watchdog/ASRS self-interference produced restart cascades.
Evaluator and actuator must be causally separated or independently validated; same-model affect agents plus keyword scoring formed a self-reinforcing measurement loop.
Central typed arbitration supersedes pairwise PID exclusions, but reload idempotency, typed outcomes, cancellation propagation and scheduler cost must be tested.
Runtime DB/memory and source artifacts require separate provenance/privacy classes; live databases appearing in source control is a release-regression oracle.
Persistence, live delivery, LLM-context admission, UI visibility and effect authority are orthogonal state dimensions.
Generated documentation and self-evaluation can overclaim or erase earlier context; immutable versioned raw evidence and supersession lineage are required.
